items.headline: 折一下，薄板也能撑起空间
items.summary: 10月27日，MIT介绍一种折纸式建造方法：平板折成小单元，连接后互相锁定，形成无需内部立柱的承重外壳。团队已制成房间大小的铝制装置。强度不仅取决于材料，也取决于几何结构；平板运输还可减少占用空间。
items.summary_en: On October 27, MIT described a construction method that folds flat sheets into units which lock together, forming load-bearing shells without internal columns. The team built a room-sized aluminium installation. Strength comes from geometry as well as material, while shipping the components flat can save space.

items.headline: 用磁珠，读出肌肉的动作
items.summary: 10月29日，MIT公布三名膝下截肢者参与的实验：肌肉内两颗磁珠的距离随收缩改变，皮肤外传感器据此计算肌肉长度与速度。受试者用这些信号控制屏幕光标，表现更准确稳定，为假肢控制提供了直接测量机械运动的新方法。
items.summary_en: On October 29, MIT reported tests with three people with below-knee amputations. As muscles contract, the distance between implanted magnetic beads changes; external sensors calculate muscle length and speed. Participants used these signals to control a screen cursor more accurately and consistently, offering a way to measure mechanical movement for future prosthetic control.

items.headline: 一块陨石，保存火星远古水迹
items.headline_en: A Meteorite Preserves Ancient Martian Water
items.summary: 10月29日，NASA介绍火星陨石Teghaza 001的测年结果：它在约四十一亿年前已受到水的改造，形成时间更早。氧同位素帮助辨认火星来源，矿物中的放射性时钟记录年代。这块落在撒哈拉的岩石，为重建早期火星地壳与水的相互作用提供线索。
items.summary_en: On October 29, NASA reported dating results for Martian meteorite Teghaza 001: water altered it around 4.1 billion years ago, so it formed earlier. Oxygen isotopes help identify its Martian origin, while radioactive clocks in minerals record its age. Found in the Sahara, the rock offers clues to interactions between water and early Martian crust.

items.headline: 磁性不只看“吸不吸”
items.summary: 10月29日，SLAC团队公布交替磁性的新证据：碲化锰对左、右旋圆偏振X射线的散射不同。它的相反自旋抵消总体磁性，但周围晶格的排列仍赋予特殊响应。这为利用电子自旋传递和储存信息提供了材料方向。
items.summary_en: On October 29, a SLAC-led team reported new evidence for altermagnetism: manganese telluride scatters left- and right-circularly polarized X-rays differently. Opposing spins cancel its overall magnetization, yet the surrounding crystal arrangement produces distinctive responses. Such materials offer a route to carrying and storing information using electron spin.

items.headline: 从星海中找出移动的世界
items.headline_en: Finding a Moving World Among Stars
items.summary: 10月27日，鲁宾天文台公布矮行星候选天体2026 ED138。算法把不同夜晚的亮点连成同一天体的轨迹，又在旧影像中找回十年前的记录。其大小初估为600至1500公里，取决于表面反光程度；连续观测让遥远世界逐渐显形。
items.summary_en: On October 27, Rubin Observatory announced dwarf-planet candidate 2026 ED138. Algorithms linked dots from different nights into one moving object, then archival images extended its record back ten years. Its estimated size is 600–1,500 kilometres, depending on surface reflectivity. Repeated observations are revealing worlds hidden among crowded background stars.

items.headline: 学蛇行走，探索弯曲肠道
items.headline_en: A Snake-Inspired Robot Explores the Gut
items.summary: 10月28日，MIT公布仿蛇软体肠镜：气腔充气使身体伸长、转弯，剪纸结构的表面展开后增加抓力。动物实验中，它沿小肠前进约两米，并演示拍摄、喷液和组织取样。柔软结构与表面设计共同解决狭窄湿滑空间中的移动难题。
items.summary_en: On October 28, MIT reported a snake-inspired soft enteroscope. Inflatable chambers extend and bend its body, while kirigami-patterned surfaces unfold to improve grip. In animal studies, it travelled about two metres through the small intestine and demonstrated imaging, spraying and tissue sampling. Soft structures and surface design work together to navigate narrow, slippery passages.

previous_answers.headline: 9枚外观相同的硬币中，恰有1枚较重，其余等重。只用无砝码的双盘天平，最坏情况下至少称几次，才能确定较重硬币？设计方法，并说明为什么不能更少。
previous_answers.headline_en: Among nine identical-looking coins, exactly one is heavier and the others have equal weight. Using only a two-pan balance without weights, what is the minimum number of weighings needed in the worst case to identify the heavier coin? Give a method and prove that fewer cannot suffice.
previous_answers.subject: W44 · 称重决策解答
previous_answers.explanation: 先取三枚对三枚称重：较重的一组含有重币；若平衡，重币就在没称的三枚中。再从嫌疑三枚中取两枚对称，即可找出重币。一次称重只有三种结果，无法区分九种可能，因此两次最少。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Weigh three coins against three. The heavier side—or the three unweighed coins if balanced—contains the heavy coin. Weigh one of those three against another to identify it. One weighing has only three outcomes, so cannot distinguish nine possibilities.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 把1至10分别写在10张卡片上，随机、不放回抽出3张，抽取顺序不计。这3个数能作为一个非退化三角形的边长的概率是多少？请用有条理的计数说明理由。
previous_answers.headline_en: Write 1 through 10 on ten cards and draw three uniformly at random without replacement, ignoring order. What is the probability that the three numbers can be side lengths of a non-degenerate triangle? Justify your answer with an organised count.
previous_answers.subject: W44 · 三角形概率解答
previous_answers.explanation: 共有120组三元组。最大边分别为3、4、…、10时，满足“两短边之和大于最长边”的组合数依次为0、1、2、4、6、9、12、16，共50组。因此概率为50/120＝5/12。
previous_answers.explanation_en: There are 120 triples. For largest side 3,4,…,10, the counts satisfying “two shorter sides sum to more than the longest” are 0,1,2,4,6,9,12,16: 50 in total. Thus 50/120 = 5/12.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 6×6棋盘按黑白相间染色，任意去掉一黑格与一白格。剩下34格是否总能用17块1×2骨牌无重叠铺满？允许旋转，不能越界。若能，给出适用于任意删格的办法；若不能，给出反例。
previous_answers.headline_en: Colour a 6×6 board alternately black and white, then remove any one black square and any one white square. Can the remaining 34 squares always be tiled by seventeen 1×2 dominoes without overlap? Rotation is allowed; dominoes must stay inside the board. Give a method that works for every pair of removed squares, or a counterexample.
previous_answers.subject: W44 · 骨牌构造解答
previous_answers.explanation: 画一条经过全部36格、只走共边相邻格的闭合路线，沿途黑白交替。删掉一黑一白后，路线分成两段，每段剩余格数均为偶数，其中一段可能为空。把每段中连续两格依次配对，每对放一块骨牌即可。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Draw a closed route through all 36 squares using edge-neighbour steps. Colours alternate. Removing one black and one white square leaves two paths, each with an even number of remaining squares; one may be empty. Pair consecutive squares on each path and place a domino on every pair.

challenges.headline: 在一张平放的圆形薄饼上切七条直线。每刀都贯穿薄饼，切出的部分不能移动或叠放。最多能得到多少块？请说明为什么不可能更多，并说明怎样达到这个数量。
challenges.headline_en: Cut a flat circular pancake with seven straight cuts. Each cut goes all the way across; you may not move or stack the pieces. What is the greatest number of pieces possible? Explain both why you cannot do better and how to attain your answer.
challenges.subject: 进阶 · 切割极值

challenges.headline: 一段楼梯共有10级，每次可以上1级或2级，但不能连续两次都上2级。从地面恰好到达第10级，共有多少种走法？只要步长顺序不同，就算不同走法。请用有条理的计数说明理由。
challenges.headline_en: A staircase has 10 steps. Each move climbs one or two steps, but two two-step moves may not occur consecutively. How many ways are there to reach step 10 exactly from the ground? Different sequences of move lengths count as different ways. Justify your count systematically.
challenges.subject: 挑战 · 楼梯计数
challenges.origin: 教学自编题面 · 经典方法，非试卷摘录

challenges.headline: 把四个非负整数按顺时针顺序写在一个圆周上。每轮同时更新四个数：用这个数与顺时针下一个数之差的绝对值替换它。计算时只能使用本轮更新前的数。先试试顺时针排列的1、3、7、12。无论开始时选哪四个非负整数，最后都会变成0、0、0、0吗？请证明。
challenges.headline_en: Write four nonnegative integers around a circle. In each round, simultaneously replace every number by the absolute difference between it and its clockwise neighbour, using the numbers from the start of that round. Try 1, 3, 7, 12 in clockwise order. Must every starting choice eventually become 0, 0, 0, 0? Prove your answer.
challenges.subject: 拓展 · 差值与不变量
